This file documents the csas resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =csas=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: D0B8F80E-1F40-58CA-8380-762A2EEDFBFC
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example

#+end_example

It is addressed at =refdata.v1.csas.list=.

#+end_src

** =add=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 0B9DC614-5DD8-5224-B4D9-57EC19359A25
:END:

Writes a row. The change states that the row must not exist, so a create that collides with an existing row is refused rather than replacing it. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
